shared_elements: schematic human figures rendered as small repeated strokes/figures in a row
vehicle or conveyance shown in profile (wheeled chariot vs boat)
registers/bands of repeated motifs stacked one above another
justification: Both surfaces show profile conveyances (a horse-drawn chariot with wheels in A, hulled boats with crew-strokes in B) accompanied by rows of repeated human figures arranged in stacked horizontal bands, which is a generic processional convention. But A depicts naturalistic, modelled figures in robes with detailed headgear, animals, wheels and architectural rosette borders, while B is a purely linear, radically schematic set of boat outlines with stick-like crew marks and no anatomical detail or ornament at all.
